newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board in the after-hours session on Friday, as private investors liquidated longs ahead of the long weekend, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.5 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.9 yen lower at 141.0 yen.

During the day, the market started the day on a slightly firmer tone, but the yen's rebound sent prices drifting lower later in the day. "Amid a lack of decisive factors, prices could move within limited ranges next week," one trader said.
